Television and music relieve or resolve the ringing
Occasional dizziness with a feeling of being a bit off-balance

Assessment.content: Left hearing difficulty for 6 weeks with intermittent left tinnitus and mild off-balance; right ear normal; no ear pain or discharge; afebrile; no chest pain
Assessment.source_text: 1) L hearing difficulty x6 wks with intermittent L tinnitus and mild off-balance; R ear OK; no otalgia/otorrhea; afebrile; no CP.

Assessment.content: Need to exclude physical blockage such as wax versus problem at eardrum or balance system
Assessment.source_text: Need to exclude physical blockage (e.g., wax) vs problem at eardrum/balance system.

Assessment.content: Mild dizziness with off-balance sensation and no room-spinning

Plan_of_Care.content: Book face-to-face ear examination with otoscopy within 4–5 days
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Book F2F ear exam (otoscopy) within 4–5 days

Plan_of_Care.content: Administrative staff to schedule the face-to-face ear exam appointment

Plan_of_Care.content: Exclude and treat physical blockage first; if ear canal is clear, consider other causes such as eardrum or vestibular problems

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide tinnitus leaflet link in visit notes for patient

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to read tinnitus leaflet before appointment
